jobDescription:
About The Role  



Skill required: NA - Business Transformation



Designation: Business Transformation Specialist



Qualifications:Any Graduation



Years of Experience:7 to 11 years

Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song?? all powered by the world??s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.



What would you do?
 Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song?? all powered by the world??s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. .You will be aligned with Operations Transformation vertical and help us provide consulting support to solve for strategic and operational business problems for our global client??s leveraging Transformation methodologies and assets. You will be working as a part of the team which drives continuous improvement projects and interact with client or internal stakeholders to drive and influence improvement objectives. This team is responsible for breaking down the end-to-end process to identify automation/improvement opportunities and create automation/transformation roadmaps. This team is also responsible for delivering large scale end-to-end process transformation projects for global clients.The Project Delivery Excellence team focuses on developing and implementing a strong foundation of processes, systems, measurements, and controls that can help deliver high-performance consistently. The team is responsible for delivering the articulated client value proposition to drive high-value outcomes for their business. They proactively identify the key issues because of which there may be any escalation from internal or external (client)stakeholders. The team typically works on Six Sigma, Lean, RPA and Transformation projects.



What are we looking for?
  • Drive continuous improvement projects and interact with client and internal stakeholders to drive and influence improvement objectives. Responsible for breaking down the end-to-end process via Lean methodologies to identify automation/improvement opportunities and create automation/transformation roadmaps
  • Well versed with Operation excellence concepts like VSMs, SOP, Process Maps, FMEA, Control Charts, RCA??s etc. and other quality methodologies
  • Should have delivered large scale end-end Process Transformation projects or have brought about process improvement in their marketing operations
  • Extensive experience in managing high-performance and cross functional teams and delivering large scale transformation projects
  • Should have delivered RPA BoT??s and have knowledge of AA / UiPath / any RPA software
  • Experience in shaping of solutions, process diagnostics, blueprinting and are savvy with PowerPoint and Excel
  • 6 - 7+ years of overall experience in Process Improvement role
  • Excellent Communication skills, result-oriented, self-driven person with a high energy level, analytical and structured
  • Six Sigma Green/Black Belt with Quality improvement and Lean Deployment background is a plus
  • Industry experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG), exposure to Sales Operations, Trade Promotions Management, Planogramming, or commercial analytics in a CPG or FMCG environment is preferred




    Roles and Responsibilities:
  • Develop or maintain process performance measurements, determine process performance baselines, and statistically analyze metrics to identify areas for process improvement. Drive projects to improve productivity and SLA performance
  • Drive strategic quality plan at the operational level, define and implement strategic initiatives to ensure success in the deployment of operational excellence practice
  • Drive rigorous metrics to evaluate performance and drive reduction in variability/defects in critical business processes
  • Identify Analytics opportunities in processes and create roadmap to transform reactive problem-solving approach to predictive and prescriptive techniques
  • Develop thorough understanding on Robotic Process Automation and drive E2E opportunity identification and implementation across processes to deliver transformational efficiency & business outcome lift
  • Drive transformational initiatives and process improvements through digitization and analytics to get real time insights of process health
  • Develop understanding Cognitive Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence- ML, Neural Networks) and identify opportunities to address problems such as unstructured and non-standard inputs, judgement etc. and deliver business impact through improved scalability, efficiency, quality and reliability
  • Develop and deliver end to end Sales Operations transformation solutions, encompassing order management, quote to cash optimization, salesforce automation, pipeline management, and commercial execution. Diagnose friction points across sales workflows and implement process and technology interventions that drive measurable efficiency, cycle time reduction, and revenue enablement
  • Develop short- and long-term strategic business plans to align resources to meet future customer needs and drive superior operating results
  • Manage quality and lean six sigma strategy to facilitate continuous improvement of services consistent with established industry standards, government regulations and customer requirements
  • Facilitate identification & execution of Process improvement projects through the operational excellence agenda and manage end to end cost optimization/digitization projects for various clients
  • Work in a matrix structure, collaborate with client/ internal stakeholders to improve processes and drive client value through intelligent marketing frameworks
  • Direct and/or support the development and implementation of the organization s managementoperating system including the training and coaching of all functional areas on measurement principles, continuous improvements, visual management

title: Associate Scientific Business Analyst - Biological Studies (LIMS)
jobDescription:
Associate Scientific Business Analyst Biological Studies (LIMS)What you will do

In this vital role you will be working closely with Amgen Research partners and Technology peers to ensure that the technology/ data needs for drug discovery research are translated into technical requirements for solution implementation. The role leverages scientific domain and business process expertise to detail product requirements as epics and user stories, along with supporting artifacts like business process maps, use cases, and test plans for the software development teams. This enables the delivery team to estimate, plan, and commit to delivery with high confidence and identify test cases and scenarios to ensure the quality and performance of IT Systems.

  • Function as a Scientific Business Systems Analyst within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) product team
  • Serve as a liaison between global Research Informatics functional areas and global research scientists, prioritizing their needs and expectations
  • Handle a suite of custom internal platforms, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software, and systems integrations
  • Lead the technology ecosystem for in vivo study data management and ensure that the platform meets their requirements for data analysis and data integrity
  • Translate complex scientific and technological needs into clear, actionable requirements for development teams
  • Develop and maintain a product roadmap that clearly outlines the planned features and enhancements, timelines, and breakthroughs
  • Identify and handle risks associated with the systems, including technological risks, scientific validation, and user acceptance
  • Develop documentations, communication plans and training plans for end users
  • Ensure scientific data operations are scoped into building Research-wide Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning capabilities
  • Ensure operational excellence, cybersecurity and compliance.
  • Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including those in the US and other international locations.
  • Develop a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. You will join a multi-functional team of scientists and software professionals that enables technology and data capabilities to evaluate drug candidates and assess their abilities to affect the biology of drug targets. This team implements LIMS platforms that enable the capture, analysis, storage, and report of pre-clinical and clinical studies as well as those that manage biological sample banks. You will collaborate with Product Owners and developers to maintain an efficient and consistent process, ensuring quality deliverables from the team. You will implement and manage scientific software platforms across the research informatics ecosystem, and provide technical support, training, and infrastructure management, and ensure it meets the needs of our Amgen Research community.

Basic Qualifications:
  • Bachelors degree and 2 to 6 years of experience in Life Sciences, Computer Science, IT, Computational Chemistry/Cheminformatics, Computational Biology/Bioinformatics or related field
  • Demonstrated expertise in a scientific domain area and related technology needs
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for tackling complex challenges in drug discovery with technology and data
  • Experience with writing user requirements and acceptance criteria in agile project management systems such as JIRA
  • Experience in configuration and administration of LIMS platforms such as STARLIMS, Watson LIMS, LabVantage, etc.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • 1+ years of experience in implementing and supporting LIMS platforms
  • Experience in the implementation of scientific software platforms, Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), or Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
  • Experience handling GxP data and system validation, and knowledge of regulatory requirements affecting laboratory data (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GLP, GCP)
  • Knowledge of bioanalytical workflows and/or biospecimen management
  • Experience in AI and machine learning for drug discovery research and preclinical development
  • Experience with cloud (e.g. AWS) and on-premise infrastructure
  • In-depth knowledge of Agile processes and principles for coordinated solutions and teams via SAFe
  • Knowledge of business analysis best practices, DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery methodology
Professional Certifications:
  • SAFe for Teams certification (preferred)
Soft Skills:
  • Able to work under minimal supervision
  • Excellent analytical and gap/fit assessment skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
  • High degree of initiative and self-motivation
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully
  • Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

Responsibilities

  • Own LinkedIn outbound by running targeted, personalised outreach to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior stakeholder buyers.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline by researching and engaging in-ICP accounts and booking qualified meetings for the UK Account Executive team.
  • Partner closely with UK Account Executives on account strategy, messaging and seamless meeting handover to ensure no opportunities are lost.
  • Conduct first-touch qualification using MEDDPICC principles to identify genuine customer challenges before handing meetings to the Account Executive team.
  • Achieve activity and outcome targets through consistent daily outreach, strong connection and reply rates, and qualified meeting bookings.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in HubSpot and manage outbound sequences using tools such as HeyReach, Smartlead and Clay/Apollo.
  • Continuously test and optimise outbound messaging and sequences to improve reply rates and conversion performance.

Requirements

  • Industry experience would be a great advantage, with a background in staff augmentation / tech talent as a service, and an understanding of the model, the buyer and the objections.
  • Alternatively, strong experience in tech recruitment and staffing outbound or SDR, with the ability to open a retained, long-term relationship rather than a one-off placement.
  • Alternatively, B2B SaaS or technology SDR/BDR experience selling to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.
  • Comfortable prospecting into CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An excellent written communicator in English, with a natural, human outbound style, not "spray and pray".
  • Highly organised and able to manage high volume without dropping quality.
  • Familiar with MEDDPICC qualification principles.
  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission and a clear path to promotions.
  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

jobDescription:
Profile :

We are hiring a world-class Prompt Engineer, someone with extreme clarity of thought, deep reasoning skills, and hands-on mastery of modern LLM behavior. It is for someone who understands prompting as a science : evaluation, ablation, latency tuning, hallucination control, guardrails and AGI-aligned orchestration.

Requirements :

- Exceptional reasoning, logic structuring and analytical thinking.

- Ability to design deterministic, controlled, and testable prompts for production behaviour.

- Deep understanding of temperature, top-p, top-k, seed, max-tokens, repetition penalty, and their effects on model behaviour.

- Strong mastery of LLM guardrails, prompt-injection defense, role separation, Meta Logic, and system level prompt design.

- Solid understanding of modern LLMs and NLP systems (GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, etc.).

- Knowledge of low-latency model families, quantization (GGUF, INT4/8), and inference trade-offs.

- Clear understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector DBs including when not to use them.

- Ability to run evaluation pipelines (accuracy, F1, hallucination rate, consistency, JSON validity).

- Highly detail-oriented, structured thinker, fast learner.

- Strong communication, able to explain reasoning clearly and concisely.

- Comfortable building measurable experiments instead of intuition-based prompting.

Responsibilities :

- Design high-accuracy prompts for reasoning, extraction, classification, and multi-step workflows.

- Build robust system + user prompt architectures with strict constraints and safety layers.

- Run temperature, seed, sampling, and ordering ablations to achieve deterministic and stable performance.

- Optimize prompts for latency, consistency, cost, and token efficiency.

- Reduce hallucinations using verification loops, guardrails, retrieval control, and role conditioning.

- Architect governing instructions for multi-agent systems and AGI-aligned assistants.

- Build hierarchical prompt layers (system -meta-controller - task-level - tools).

- Select models based on latency, throughput, context window, and domain-specific performance.

- Collaborate with AI engineers on quantization, distillation, caching, and runtime optimizations.

- Maintain versioned prompt libraries with clear documentation, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.

- Work closely with ML, product, and engineering teams to deliver production-grade, scalable prompt flows.

- Write clear technical documents : architecture diagrams, ablation summaries, evaluation reports, and runbooks.

jobDescription:
Transformation Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. You will lead the end-to-end transformation execution, ensuring programs deliver committed business outcomes, financial targets, operational improvements, and stakeholder expectations across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Transformation Delivery
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 12 - 17 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions.

Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.
  • Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.
  • Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.
  • Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.
  • Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
  • Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
  • Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.
  • Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.
  • Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.

What We''re Looking For

  • 12 17 years total experience; 4 6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M $30M range.
  • Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

  • Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.
  • Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.
  • Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.
  • Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management.

Set yourself apart:

  • Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
  • Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
  • Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
  • Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
  • Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient


What s in it for you

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
  • Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everything from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions underpinned by the world s largest delivery network Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

About Digital Core Reinvention Partner:

Digital Core Reinvention Partner helps clients reinvent their digital foundations including technology strategy and architecture, AI and data, modernizing and managing applications, infrastructure, and cloud. We operate in lockstep with our Reinvention Engines especially Technology and AI and Data. In practice, Digital Core brings the integrated client solution and team together, while the Engines continuously strengthen the skills, tools, methods, and AI-enabled delivery that those teams use. And Client Success will ensure our solutions are commercially strong, repeatable, and aligned to what clients truly need bringing the full strength of Accenture to every engagement. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Digital Core Reinvention Partner s services include those provided by our Global Network a distributed organization that provides advisory and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world.

title: Software Engineer II
jobDescription:
Software Engineer II

POSITION PURPOSE:

We are hiring a hands-on Backend Engineer to build, operate, and own the microservices that power FarmRise a platform that puts agronomic advice directly into the hands of smallholder farmers. This is not a role where you hand off deployment and operations to someone else: you will design the service, write the code, own the AWS infrastructure it runs on, and be the first call when it breaks in production.

You will work across services spanning user onboarding, agronomy, commodity pricing, news/events, and third-party integrations. We are looking for someone who treats a production incident or an ambiguous requirement as their problem to solve, not someone waiting to be assigned a ticket.

What You Will Own End to End

  • Service design architecture: design and evolve Java + Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs consumed by the FarmRise mobile app and internal platforms; make and document trade-offs on data modeling, service boundaries, and API contracts.
  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS): own the full runtime your services live on ECS/Fargate for compute, RDS/Aurora Postgres for persistence, S3 for storage, CloudWatch/CloudTrail for logs and audit, SNS/AmazonMQ for messaging, CloudFront for delivery, ElastiCache for caching plus IAM, VPC/networking, and secrets management. You provision, tune, and troubleshoot this infrastructure yourself, not through a separate DevOps team.
  • Async event-driven systems: design event/queue-based workflows on RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) producers, consumers, retry and dead-letter handling, idempotency, and back-pressure for resilient, decoupled processing.
  • Data layer: design Postgres schemas, indexes, and queries for correctness and performance at scale; own migrations and query optimization as data volume grows.
  • Observability reliability: instrument services with structured logging and metrics (Datadog/CloudWatch), define SLOs, set up alerting, and drive scalability, availability, and fault-tolerance practices across the platform.
  • CI/CD quality: maintain build and release pipelines (GitHub Actions, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, JUnit); keep test coverage, code quality gates, and deployment safety nets healthy.
  • Security: apply JWT-based auth patterns and platform security conventions; treat data privacy and secure coding as a default, not an afterthought.

What You Will Do Day to Day

  • Ship backend features and services against explicit expectations for reliability, latency, and cost not just it works on my machine.
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS, including scaling decisions, cost tuning, and incident response when something breaks in production.
  • Debug production issues end-to-end using logs, metrics, and traces and own the fix, not just the diagnosis.
  • Build and evolve shared libraries, interceptors, and API standards that improve developer experience across the platform.
  • Use AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) deliberately to speed up code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation while following secure coding and data privacy practices.
  • Partner directly with product, mobile, and platform teams to turn ambiguous requirements into scoped, reliable services and push back when a request is not the right build.
  • Review code from other engineers with a focus on quality, performance, security, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE:

Required:

  • 4 10 years of backend engineering experience building and operating production services not just writing code that others deploy.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design, with real production systems you can walk through in depth.
  • Proven, hands-on AWS experience: you have personally deployed, scaled, and debugged services on ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, S3, and CloudWatch including IAM and VPC/networking troubleshooting. You do not need someone else to touch the AWS console for you.
  • Solid grounding in microservices patterns service boundaries, contract design, versioning, and scaling services independently.
  • Practical, past experience with Postgres: schema design, indexing, and query optimization on production workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with messaging/async systems, especially RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) including retries, dead-letter queues, and idempotent consumers.
  • Practical CI/CD experience: Git-based workflows, build tooling (Maven/Gradle), code quality gates (SonarQube), and unit testing (JUnit) as a default practice, not an exception.
  • Strong, independent debugging skills across logs, metrics, and distributed systems you can own a production issue from alert to resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation, applied with secure coding and data privacy discipline.
  • Ownership mindset: a demonstrated track record of taking a problem statement, scoping it, and driving it to production without needing constant direction.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with JWT auth flows and API gateway/routing patterns.
  • Experience with caching strategies and HTTP caching concepts (ETags, max-age headers).
  • Exposure to serverless patterns (Lambda), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and additional data stores (Redis/NoSQL).
  • Experience operating services with centralized logging/monitoring stacks (Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Prior experience in Agri-tech, agri-inputs, rural commerce, or similar domains serving high-scale, low-connectivity users.

Engineering Solutions Design

Contribute to the development of and implement feasibility testing of proposed engineering solutions to provide feedback and data to validate the design.

Engineering Standards Specification

Carry out a range of activities under the guidance of more senior colleagues to support the drafting of engineering standards and specifications and the evaluation of the effectiveness of those standards.

Engineering Inspections

Carry out inspections under the supervision of senior colleagues to evaluate the quality of engineering works and/or the integrity of existing installations or structures, and make recommendations to senior colleagues on the remedial works needed to ensure conformance with specifications and regulatory requirements.

Contract Management

Deliver required outcomes by coordinating activities of subcontractors and suppliers and acting as a primary point of contact for them while working within an established contract management plan.

Improvement/Innovation

Identify shortcomings in existing processes, systems and procedures, and use established change management programs to address them.

Help others get the most out of knowledge management systems by offering support and advice.

Product and/or Solution Development

Project Management

Work within an established project management plan to achieve specific goals.

Manages Complexity

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on producing technical engineering specifications and related materials.

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on testing, evaluating and improving engineering outcomes.

Builds engineering solutions without supervision and provides technical guidance on these solutions as needed.

Project Schedule Management

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on sequencing and scheduling tasks into a project plan.

Engineering Implementation

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on implementing engineering designs, evaluating outcomes and then making improvements as needed.

Health and Safety

Manages and applies safe systems of work without supervision and provides technical guidance when required.

Negotiation

Policy and Regulation

Review and Reporting

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on reviewing and creating relevant, lucid and effective reports.

Risk Management

Identifies, assesses, prioritizes and manages risks without supervision and provides technical guidance when required.

Policy and procedures

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on interpreting and understanding policies and procedures, while making sure they match organizational strategies and objectives.

A Brief Overview

This is a high-impact, execution-focused role responsible for building and delivering AI-powered agents and agentic workflows that address critical business challenges. You will partner closely with Data Analytics (DA) leaders and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable agentic designs, working solutions, and production-ready implementations.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams to design and deliver scalable, secure, and compliant AI solutions in enterprise environments. This role is ideal for someone who excels at translating business needs into clear requirements and delivering high-quality AI agents that operate reliably within real-world workflows.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Agent Configuration:

  • Lead the design, build, and testing of AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs), leveraging prompt engineering, tool use, reasoning workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Convert business needs into requirements, designs, workflow logic, system interactions, and implementation plans.
  • Create and maintain specifications for agent behavior, workflow orchestration, tool interactions, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop paths to support reliable implementation and deployment.
  • Coordinate integration of AI agents with enterprise platforms, APIs, and data sources, building the connectivity, retrieval patterns, and workflow components needed to enable secure, connected, end-to-end business execution.
  • Establish evaluation, testing, and monitoring practices for AI outputs, including quality checks, failure handling, tuning, and issue triage to improve safety, reliability, and performance in production.
  • Productionize AI agents by supporting deployment, validation, release readiness, post-production monitoring, and ongoing optimization in partnership with platform and engineering teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Leadership:

  • Partner with Product, Technology, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to define priorities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria, and drive effective delivery of AI solutions into target workflows.
  • Collaborate with Security, Legal, and Compliance partners to ensure implementations align with user and operational needs while incorporating required controls, privacy standards, and responsible AI practices.
  • Drive strong execution standards through disciplined implementation practices, code quality, testing rigor, and clear documentation across delivered solutions.
  • Communicate decisions, implementation trade-offs, delivery risks, and production readiness clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to deliver complex AI solutions with limited oversight.

Governance, Reliability Responsible AI:

  • Embed responsible AI principles and sound controls into solution design, including guardrails, fallback mechanisms, and audit-ready logging.
  • Help ensure AI solutions align with enterprise governance, security, and acceptable-use standards, including appropriate human oversight for sensitive use cases.
  • Design for reliability and scale by establishing monitoring, alerting, performance metrics, and resilience patterns for production environments.
  • Support production deployment and ongoing operations through version control, release processes, testing discipline, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Deliver AI capabilities that are innovative, secure, compliant, and reliable in production.

Required Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Must-Have Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in business analysis, software development, or related fields, with a track record of designing and delivering automation and technology solutions in production environments.
  • Experience defining and orchestrating complex automated workflows, including multi-step business processes, system integrations, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop activities.
  • Experience defining integration requirements and enabling connectivity across enterprise platforms, APIs, and data sources to support end-to-end business workflows.
  • Experience supporting the delivery and ongoing operation of production solutions, including coordinating testing, validating requirements, ensuring release readiness, and monitoring performance post-launch.

Nice-To-Have Experience:

  • Hands-on or applied experience with machine learning, predictive models, or AI-enabled solutions in real-world use cases.
  • Familiarity with agent-based or intelligent automation workflows, including orchestration, tool integration, and decision-driven processes.
  • Experience developing and supporting AI-enabled capabilities within enterprise systems and business workflows.
  • Exposure to operationalizing AI solutions, including evaluation, performance monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production environments.

Skills and Abilities:

About the role
Job Overview
Were looking for an AI engineer with genuine depth across three areas that most people only have one of: classical ML, LLMs, and computer vision . Our problems dont fit neatly into one bucket. A single workflow might involve a vision-language model extracting fields from a 40-year-old scanned sale deed, a ranking model deciding which retrieved records matter, and an LLM-powered agent reasoning over the results to flag title risks.
Youll work on systems that are already in production and used by real customers making high-stakes property decisions - not research prototypes.


What Youll Work On
  • Document understanding at scale. Fine-tuning VLMs (Qwen, Nemotron, Kimi family models using LoRA adapters) for classification, layout analysis, and field extraction across Indian property documents - handwritten, scanned, stamped, multilingual, and frequently degraded.
  • Classical ML where it earns its keep. Ranking and retrieval (BM25 and learned rankers), entity resolution across noisy government records, fraud/anomaly detection, and calibration of model confidence for legal-grade outputs.
  • LLM agents in production. Improving our conversational agents for land-records search and title diligence - tool design, context management, evaluation harnesses, and cost/latency optimization.
  • Evaluation and data infrastructure. Designing annotation taxonomies, building eval sets that reflect real document distributions, and closing the loop from production failures back into training data.
What Were Looking For
  • 6 10 years building ML systems in production, with shipped work across at least two of: classical ML, LLMs/NLP, computer vision.
  • Strong fundamentals - you can reason about why a model fails, not just swap in a bigger one. Comfort with the full lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight models ( LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, preference optimization ) or training CV/document models (detection, layout, OCR pipelines).
  • Practical LLM engineering: prompt and context design, structured/constrained outputs, RAG, agent tool design, building evals that actually predict production quality.
  • Solid Python and the engineering discipline to write code teammates can build on. Experience with PyTorch and the modern inference stack ( vLLM or similar) is a plus.
  • Pragmatism. You pick the simplest approach that solves the problem - sometimes thats a gradient-boosted tree, sometimes its an 8B VLM with constrained decoding.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Indic languages, OCR for degraded documents, or multilingual NLP.
  • Work on agentic systems, multi-step tool use, or LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Exposure to legal, fintech, or other high-stakes domains where correctness and provenance matter.
  • Contributions to open-source ML tooling or published applied work.


Your First 90 Days
Days 1 30: Ground truth. Ship a small improvement to a production model or eval in week one. Read real documents and real transcripts - sale deeds, ECs, agent conversations - until you understand why this data breaks naive approaches. Own one document types extraction quality end to end.
Days 31 60: Own a model surface. Take full ownership of one pipeline - say, an extraction adapter for a major state or the retrieval/ranking layer - including its eval set, error analysis, and a measurable quality lift youve shipped to production.
Days 61 90: Shape the roadmap. Propose and begin executing a meaningful bet - a new adapter architecture, a better eval harness, a classical-ML component that cuts cost or error - backed by evidence from your first 60 days. By now your judgment should be influencing what the team builds next, not just how.


Why This Role
  • Frontier applied-AI problems with no playbook - nobody has solved document intelligence for Indian land records.
  • Direct impact: your models decide whether a familys property purchase is safe.
  • Small, senior team with high ownership; youll shape architecture, not just implement tickets.
  • Backed by Y Combinator and top investors, with real revenue and real customers.
Why Join Landeed
  • High-Impact Role : Shape the AI backbone of a cutting-edge real estate platform that transforms how millions access property information.
  • Fast-Growing Startup : Join a dynamic, collaborative environment in Hyderabad, where your ideas and expertise will be valued.
  • Competitive Compensation : Receive a fixed salary plus equity , aligning your success with the company s growth.
  • Professional Growth : Work with talented peers and stay at the frontier of AI/ML innovations in NLP and information retrieval.


About the interview
We move fast - the full loop takes 5-7 days, and well give you a decision within 48 hours of your final round.
  • Intro call (30 min). Mutual fit, your background, what youre looking for. Well walk you through the problem space.
  • Technical deep-dive (60 min). A past ML system you shipped, interrogated properly: data, modeling choices, failure modes, what youd redo. Were probing for depth and honesty, not buzzwords.
  • Work sample (take-home or paired, your choice, ~3 hrs). A scoped problem on real (anonymized) property-document data e.g., design and partially implement an extraction + eval approach.
  • System design + eval round (60 min). Design a production pipeline for a Landeed problem end to end, including how youd measure it. Expect pushback.
  • Founder conversation (45 min). Values, ambition, and your questions about where the company is going.


About Landeed
Two thirds of Indian court cases are land related. Our solution to this is the Landeed, Indias fastest and most comprehensive title search engine. We are now actively growing our engineering and product teams to expand our title coverage to more Indian states and build an enterprise platform for government bodies and corporates alike.

jobDescription:
Senior Business Analyst

Product Development Job Roles Responsibilities

  1. Be the Operational Truth Source for the Platform. You will be accountable for validating that platform outputs make sense in the real world. This includes:
  • Reviewing payer contracts, amendments, and fee schedules
  • Interpreting real-world contract logic (lesser-of, modifiers, MCO products, effective dates)
  • Reading raw 835 remits and identifying: Reimbursement issues vs legitimate adjustments; Payer miss configuration vs provider error; Systemic vs one-off issues
  • Calling out false positives and explaining why something is not a true issue. If something looks technically correct but operationally wrong, you are expected to stop it.
  1. Own Synthetic Data Realism (Critical). The platform will initially rely on synthetic data for development and validation. You will:
  • Define what realistic synthetic data looks like: payer mix, CARC/RARC distributions, modifier usage patterns, underpayment frequency and dollar impact
  • Review synthetic data sets and flag unrealistic assumptions
  • Guide engineers and vendors on correcting synthetic data generation logic. This role protects the credibility of everything we build.
  1. Be Deeply Embedded in Testing Validation. You will be hands-on in:
  • Reviewing detection outputs and classifying true vs false positives
  • Validating confidence scores against operational reality
  • Helping define suggested next step classifications (appeal, rebill, review, do not pursue)
  • Testing against real customer data during pilot phases. Your feedback will directly shape detection logic, confidence thresholds, and future AI agent behavior. You are effectively the human-in-the-loop backbone of the system.
  1. Act as the RCM Counterweight in Vendor Engagements. You will actively participate in vendor evaluations, technical reviews, and edge-case discussions. You will:
  • Ask uncomfortable but necessary questions
  • Spot hand-wavy answers around contracts or EDI
  • Distinguish between can build, has built, and is guessing
  • This role is critical to holding vendors accountable and ensuring delivery meets operational standards.
  1. Help Carry the Long-Term Platform Vision Forward. While the MVP starts with underpayments, the platform is designed to evolve toward:
  • Broader reimbursement correctness (denials, old AR, charge capture)
  • Recommendation intelligence and outcome monitoring
  • Selective automation with AI agents
  • Contract renegotiation insights. You will help ensure core data models are reusable, intelligence is generalized, and we t hard-code short term assumptions that block long-term evolution.

  • 6-10+ years in health care RCM revenue integrity, payer contracts, payment analysis, denials, or A/R

  • Deep knowledge of payer contracts and fee schedules percent of Medicare, lesser-of, MCO products, modifier rules, effective dates

  • Comfortable saying this would never happen in production

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage

jobDescription:
Location: Bengaluru, Visakhapatnam, Delhi, Mohali, Nashik

Language Requirement: English (Expert)

Role Overview

We are looking for an exceptionally sharp Process Consultant someone who operates at the intersection of business understanding, process design, and technology feasibility.

The person we hire will be the intellectual engine of our transformation engagements: the consultant who walks into a clients business, rapidly builds the first-principles understanding of how that business actually works and makes money, diagnoses where value is leaking, and designs future-state processes that are not just elegant on paper but technically feasible, automation-ready, and commercially sound.

You will be trusted to challenge how clients operate today, to tell them what should be automated and just as importantly what should not, and to translate ambiguous business problems into structured, buildable solutions. You will work primarily within Finance and Accounting environments, applying Business Process Management (BPM), Intelligent Automation, AI, and Digital Transformation methodologies.

  • Who You Are
    • Intellectually rigorous. You have a strong academic record and demonstrable analytical horsepower. You think in structures, frameworks, and first principles not templates. You can hold a complex, multi-entity, multi-system business in your head and reason about it.

    • A genuine business consultant, not just a process mapper. You understand the clients business model, revenue drivers, cost structure, and regulatory context before you touch a single process map. Your recommendations start from business needs and work backward to solutions.

    • Fluent in technical feasibility. You know what RPA, AI, IDP, workflow platforms, and process mining can and cannot do. You can assess whether a proposed solution is buildable, scalable, and maintainable and you can defend that assessment to both a CFO and a solution architect.

    • Comfortable with ambiguity. You can enter an engagement with no playbook, structure the problem yourself, and produce clarity where none existed.

Requirements
Provide subject matter expertise across Finance and Accounting operations, including:
  • Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR)
  • General Ledger (GL), Financial Close Reconciliation
  • Cash Application, Billing Invoicing
  • Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R)

  • Procurement and Shared Service Center Operations

Business Understanding Process Discovery
  • Rapidly develop a deep understanding of each clients business model, operating context, industry dynamics, and strategic priorities.
  • Lead discovery workshops with stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • Analyze current-state (AS-IS) processes, systems, controls, handoffs, and pain points.
  • Conduct structured process assessments to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, compliance risks, and automation opportunities.
  • Evaluate process maturity and readiness for automation, standardization, and transformation.
Process Design Transformation
  • Design optimized future-state (TO-BE) processes aligned with best practices, business objectives, and automation principles.
  • Challenge existing operating models; recommend improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, control, and customer experience.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps and prioritized improvement initiatives grounded in business value.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Define business rules, exception-handling frameworks, governance structures, and operational controls.
Technical Feasibility Solution Shaping
  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed solutions across RPA, AI, workflow automation, OCR/IDP, and process mining before commitments are made to clients.
  • Identify the right automation candidates and, critically, flag processes that are poor automation candidates and require redesign or human judgment.
  • Work closely with Solution Architects and Automation Developers to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Lead automation opportunity assessments and ROI/business-case development.
  • Ensure redesigned processes are automation-ready before development begins.
  • Participate in solution design workshops and client presentations as the voice of both business logic and technical realism.
Experience

Required

  • 5+ years in Process Consulting, Business Process Transformation, Operational Excellence, Finance Transformation, or Shared Services Optimization.
  • Proven track record redesigning finance and accounting processes end to end.
  • Experience leading client-facing process discovery and consulting engagements.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing solution feasibility and shaping automation scope.

Preferred

  • Background in consulting firms (Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG, Accenture, IBM Consulting, Capgemini, Genpact, Infosys, Cognizant) or in the finance transformation team of a multinational organization.
Technical Skills
  • Strong command of BPM methodologies and advanced process mapping (Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, Bizagi, ARIS).
  • Working knowledge of process mining tools (Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).
  • Solid understanding of RPA platforms (UiPath, Power Automate), AI-enabled automation, Intelligent Document Processing, and workflow automation platforms sufficient to judge feasibility, effort, and risk.
  • Experience with major ERPs is a benefit: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday Financials.
Certifications (Preferred)
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
  • CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional)
  • CBPP / CBPA Certification (Certified Business Process Professional / Associate)
  • UiPath Business Analyst Certification
  • Prosci Change Management Certification
  • Finance or Accounting certifications


Benefits

In addition to all mandatory statutory benefits (PF, group medical insurance, gratuity, etc.), we offer:

  • Professional certifications sponsored based on your interests and career progression
  • Structured professional development programs designed around your career growth
  • Rewards and recognition for star performers
  • International travel opportunities meet clients for on-site training and represent the company at industry events and conferences
  • Six months paid maternity leave
  • Committee membership of your choice ISO, Sustainability, CSR, Training and Development, Health and Wellness, Rewards and Recognition, Entertainment, and more
  • Team building activities and a culture that puts employees first
  • The chance to be part of a Centre of Excellence like no other

AI - IT/OT Network Infrastructure Security Manager

Role summary

We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network Infrastructure Security Manager to act as the technical owner for client-facing network Infrastructure Security transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands-on manager who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models).

This role is part of the Cyber Frontier AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
  • Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
  • Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.

  • Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
  • Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
  • Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
  • Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
  • Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
  • Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
  • Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
